Temple donation irregularities prompt probes across India

Multiple temple committees and government bodies in India have initiated investigations into alleged financial irregularities and donation disputes. These probes involve prominent religious sites like Badrinath and the Ram Temple in Ayodhya, as well as public service commission appointments in Kerala. The developments have drawn attention to transparency and accountability in religious institutions and public administration.
